subject.title: Device pairing: bind setup codes to node approvals

question: Should this protected maintainer PR be closed as superseded by the merged profile-based setup-code/bootstrap handoff work, or rewritten against the current contract?
rationale: Automation should not close maintainer-labeled PRs, and the remaining choice is ownership/process: close the stale branch or have a maintainer deliberately rebase/rewrite it without regressing the current security boundary.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Close this PR and keep the current profile-based setup-code/bootstrap contract from the merged follow-up PRs as the canonical implementation.

options.title: Rewrite on current main
options.body: Rebase or replace the branch with a narrow patch that preserves PAIRING_SETUP_BOOTSTRAP_PROFILE, operator.talk.secrets gating, and current gateway/mobile tests.

options.title: Keep parked
options.body: Leave the protected PR open only as a historical reference while maintainers decide ownership of the stale branch.

recommendation.title: Close as superseded
recommendation.body: Close this PR and keep the current profile-based setup-code/bootstrap contract from the merged follow-up PRs as the canonical implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: ngutman authored the canonical merged handoff restoration and later scope hardening that current main follows.
